_comment: Per-level conversion spec. Holds ONLY our own choices and indexes into the user's disc (string ordinals in DATA/chars.bum, stream indexes in banks, segment numbers in main.mus) - never Frontline text or data. The converter resolves them on the player's PC and writes the result into the generated pk3 only.

1_1._barks: [flpolish] the four road/square shouters (classes Soldier_SayIncoming / SayGetOutOfTheOpen / SayTheyreAfterTheTanks / SayPlanesAbove): unsubtitled German lines in the same script bank, matched to their classes by transcribing the decoded samples locally; no subtitle, as on the disc
1_1.place: Pointe Saint-Mathieu (St. Mathieu), Finistere, Brittany, France
1_1._place_source: disc: briefing journal 1_1_bLog.viv page j1_1_pg1 header 'SEASIDE STOWAWAY / St. Mathieu, France / 17 August 1944 - 0900 Hours'; location table chars.bum @0x2bd0 (= shell.viv @0x10a36d0). Real place: Pointe Saint-Mathieu lighthouse/abbey near Brest - matches the dock dialogue about docking near the lighthouse. No St. Nazaire / St. Malo / Periers strings on the disc; the 'Periers 7 km' road sign is level-only dressing art, not the setting. Levels 1_3/1_4 = 'Shipyards of Lorient, France'. Chrono: before AA M5 (20 Aug 1944, Brest).

1_1._motions: [flpolish] set-piece motion paths the mission script plays by origin-stepping (flscene.path_lines): the jeep's run down the road into the mine and its four wheels flying off - Frontline's own .mvd keys, sampled every motion_step frames; the rate is the .mvd header's (1 or 2 game ticks of 1/60 s per frame, flscene.mvd_frames). [flfix2 bug-11080] set-piece keys parent/after/hold/stop: a child runs on its parent's clock - made 'after' seconds after the parent starts, waits 'hold', and stops 'stop' seconds into its own keys (emulator trace of the bomber pass, TRACE_bombers.md: bombs made at +153 and +219 ticks, on the ground at +261 and +309, the house goes at +303)
1_1._motion_first: [flpolish] the key a motion starts from, named outright (else flpack's collision sweep picks the first key whose run is open). The jeep starts at Frontline's own key 1 behind the farm gate again: it used to be forced to key 20 because a start past x 8192 was never drawn - the entity-origin wire format wraps at +-8192 (bug-flp-jeepdraw); the converter now opts the map into the HZM engine's wide coordinates (worldspawn hzm_widecoords).
1_1._marks: [flfix2 round 9] disc records the mission script needs a spot / radius for (decoded scene, cbs_decode SCENES.md 1): the trigger whose two projectile generators fire at the jeep, the generators, the second bump trigger, the wreck's gun (its 6.2 m player range)
1_1._set_pieces: [flpolish] which Frontline motion plays when, and as what: 'mesh' = Frontline's own object mesh from the player's disc (flconvert builds it as an inline model), 'model' = a stock MOHAA stand-in when there is none. 'trigger'/'object' are Frontline RECORD indexes resolved on the player's PC. Planes go to the trigger their flight passes closest to (unique assignment; the untriggered start pass and the two dogfights open over the drop); bombs and rockets to the triggers that send them; the house chunks fall when the second bomb lands beside them (its fall is 3.4 s); the jeep's wheels fly off on the jeep's own clock from the mine hit ('sync'); the U-boat bobs all mission.
1_1._hd: [flfix2] tier-1 textures (flhd.py; docs/proposals/flpolish_2026-11-10/TEXTURES.md). swap: texture id -> CC0 asset in hd/ (Poly Haven, CC0, hd/CREDITS.txt), laid under the disc texture's own low-frequency light/dark map (overlay 0..1, flhd.bake) so stains and wear stay where Frontline had them; repeat = how many times the new tile repeats inside one repeat of the old one (old world units per repeat / tile, rounded, at least 1). cutout: tree and bush cards upscaled 4x locally. Signs, house fronts and anything with a feature at a fixed place are never listed. Tried and withdrawn after review (kept original): cobbles 54200 and b3600 (replacement read as a clean regular sett grid), stone wall 4aa80 (rubble versus the original's coursed blocks).

ladders.note: bridge tower: drawn ladder c4_feb00 on the inside of the west wall (plane x=1065, y 2258..2282, z -209..431); shaft floor z -160, platform z 439, hatch x 1076..1115

1_1._ladders: [flfix2] climbable ladders, in UN-mirrored map units. base = foot of the ladder at the climbing face, yaw = the way a climber faces (into the wall), height = to just above the floor he climbs to, exit = where he is set down at the top (the original steps off through a hatch; the coop ladder recipe cannot dismount sideways). Found with H:/hzm_work/flpolish/fix2/findladder.py (narrow tall vertical strips of one material).
1_1._route_widen: [flpolish] [x, y, radius] in map units: spots where a route of the original squeezes past a post or a wall end and the route cut (flroutes.carve) is sampled finely. Reviewed one by one against the walk audit (fall-outs must stay 0) - doing it everywhere opens the walls beside the routes.
1_1._object_meshes: [flpolish] Frontline object meshes that stand on their own record (inline models): the door (DoorSwingCW, solid while shut, swings open when its group wakes). With 'class' instead of 'object': one per record of that class, named <name><n> in record order - the exploding barrels and the molotov barrel (mesh packs: #0 intact, #1 the wreck the original swaps in).
1_1._clip_keep: [flpolish] Frontline player-clip sheets (disc chunk, triangle index) that STAY: they bound the playable area where nothing is drawn, and get a visible barbed-wire edge (flsheets.edges). Every other non-walkable sheet is dropped and the drawn geometry behind it collides instead. Curated with the walk audit (docs/proposals/flpolish_2026-11-10/sheetiter.py): drop all, keep the sheets where the walker got out of the level.
